x.body:
I pay for the pleasure to be here.

And realistically, I will never break even.

Unless I dramatically change my content. 

And I can see the appeal.

A lot of content creators will do whatever it takes to get ad revenue share from Social Media, and affiliate commissions from shady prop firms or crypto exchanges.

That's why most trading content looks like it's from the same play-book. Because it is. 

I am locked into a niche I can't break out of, unless I stop making this about truthful tradin
